scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @flightguard/api && npm run build -w @flightguard/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @flightguard/contracts" "npm run dev -w @flightguard/api" "npm run dev -w @flightguard/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @flightguard/api && npm run typecheck -w @flightguard/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @flightguard/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
